column1: # One row per buildable image cell: (platform, role, env, board, flavor, desktop).
# "-" = axis not applicable to that platform. Every row must be buildable from
# EVERY channel (CLI --print-plan, make target, ncurses menu, Studio GUI) — the
# walks this file; `make matrix-check` runs it.
# --board rpi4 (Phase 6, Pi 4 support): SAME "rpi5" platform id / builder script
# (build-rpi5-stage4.sh --board rpi4) — the board column is the axis, not a
# separate platform. Mirrors the rpi5-default rows above 1:1 (role x env).
# omnibus (one node running every cluster role) on the Raspberry Pi 5 only. Needs
# --ram-gb 16 or more (the Pi 4 tops out at 8 GB and is refused it);
# tests/build-matrix/check.sh probes these rows with MATRIX_OMNIBUS_RAM_GB=16 on
# every channel (matrix.tsv has no RAM column).
# --board rpi3 (Phase 8, Pi 3 support): SAME "rpi5" platform id / builder
# script (build-rpi5-stage4.sh --board rpi3) — DESKTOP-ONLY (1GB RAM is not
# enough headroom for the k8s cluster-node stack), so only the desktop role is
# rowed here (unlike rpi4/rpi5, which mirror all 4 cluster-node+desktop roles).
# standalone-desktop (ARM standalone-posture JOB-channel grammar): the SAME
# --role desktop the plain "desktop" rows above resolve, but the JOB channel's
# HARDWARE_CLASS grammar spells it as its own role token ("rpi5.standalone-desktop.<board>")
# since rpi5 has a role axis to extend the way x86's standalone-thin/thick/
# unaffiliated roles do — see docker/build-image.sh's header comment. The CLI/
# MAKE/GUI/MENU channels have no such token (the builder itself only ever takes
# --role desktop plus a separate --standalone flag), so tests/build-matrix/check.sh's
# CLI leg translates this role value into the real --role desktop --standalone
# invocation before executing it, and its GUI leg translates it to the real
# Studio posture (role=desktop + standalone=true, the HomePage checkbox) and
# proves the printed command against the builder's own --print-plan.
# flavor=standalone (ARM standalone-posture JOB-channel grammar): frite has NO
# role axis, so the JOB channel signals standalone-posture through the flavor
# slot instead ("frite.<board>.standalone") — normalized to the real
# flavor=installer (--standalone forces the installer path internally anyway)
# plus --standalone/--local-user by the CLI leg, and to flavor=installer +
# standalone=true (ImageConfig semantics, --print-plan-proven) by the GUI leg.
# flavor=standalone (ARM standalone-posture JOB-channel grammar): same shape as
# frite's — no role axis, so standalone rides the flavor slot, normalized to
# Orange Pi 5 / 5 Plus CLUSTER NODE roles — EXPERIMENTAL (hardware validation
# pending). Installer flavor only (a node needs a persistent root); omnibus rows are
# flavor=standalone (ARM standalone-posture JOB-channel grammar): same shape as
# frite/orangepi5's — no role/board axis at all, so standalone rides the
# orangepizero2w — the Zero 2's Allwinner H618 sibling (EXPERIMENTAL, headless
# appliance, one board, flavor-only). Same 6+2 row shape as orangepizero2.
# orangepizero3 — the Zero 2's Allwinner H618 sibling (EXPERIMENTAL, headless
# appliance, one board, flavor-only). Same 6+2 row shape as orangepizero2.
# orangepi3-lts — Allwinner H6, a generation BEFORE the Zero 2's H616 and NOT
# appliance; boots the PLAIN OPi3's mainline DTB/defconfig — no -lts variant
# upstream; USB-Ethernet-first: the GbE jack is dead on that DTB). Same
# flavor-only shape; "standalone" is the same JOB-channel-only probe token.
# orangepi4-lts — Rockchip RK3399 (EXPERIMENTAL). The FIRST Orange Pi platform
# here that is a genuine LIGHT DESKTOP rather than a headless appliance: the
# mainline rk3399-orangepi.dts it boots has an enabled Mali-T860 &gpu, an
# enabled &hdmi and both VOPs, so the role column is "desktop" (matching
# orangepi5), NOT "appliance". Single board though — mainline ships ONE Orange
# Pi RK3399 DTB/defconfig for the whole 4/4B/4 LTS family, so the board column
# is "-" like the appliances rather than orangepi5's two-board axis. No desktop
# column value for the same reason orangepi5 has none: one role, no headless
# variant to gate. "standalone" is the same JOB-channel-only probe token.
# Orange Pi 4 LTS frontend CLUSTER NODE — EXPERIMENTAL; its only node role (4 GB RAM,
